lead.headline: A defence claimed, a kicker swapped — and Marks is still out
lead.deck: The Steelers replaced the Rams' bye at the cost of a claim. Hampton is now free, but there is no clean seat for him.
lead.body: Bad news first: Woody Marks is not expected to clear the concussion protocol for Thursday while Montgomery progresses; Josh Jacobs is out and on bye; Golden is on bye; Garrett Wilson's quarterback starts only if he practises. Overnight you claimed the Steelers D/ST for the Rams — the right drop, but it spent priority that never resets — and swapped Zvada for Boswell. The lineup as set is the projection lineup. Omarion Hampton cleared to free agency; he would not start this week, and Marks' open thesis keeps his seat until Thursday decides it.

doFirst.headline: Nothing to do today
doFirst.deck: The lineup is the projection lineup; the D/ST and kicker seats were filled overnight.
doFirst.note: Thursday's Houston report decides whether Marks' seat opens for Hampton.
doFirst.empty: Nothing to do before Thursday: the lineup is the projection lineup and the Hampton add waits on Houston's report.
